en.title: Settings — OverText
en.autoHint: Automatically reads Japanese, Chinese and English. For other languages, select the image language above.
en.windowsHint: Windows OCR reads installed languages only. Select the image language and install its Windows OCR language pack.
en.fallbackHint: PaddleOCR will be used when Windows does not have the OCR language pack.
en.sourceHint: Select the image language independently of the translation language.
en.paddleInstalled: PaddleOCR is installed. Models download on first use; OCR then runs locally.
en.paddleHint: Install PaddleOCR for automatic Japanese / Chinese / English recognition and languages missing from Windows. Internet is needed to download the recognizer; images are processed locally.
en.installProgress: Downloading and verifying the OCR runtime and models. This may take a few minutes…
en.installDone: OCR is ready. Save settings and capture again.
en.freeHint: Uses unofficial Google endpoints with MyMemory as a fallback. Limits or service changes may occur at any time.
en.savedKey: Stored securely — leave blank to keep it
en.keyHint: Captured text is sent to the server above. Keys are stored in Keychain (macOS) or Credential Manager (Windows). If this service fails, the app reports the error without sending text to another service.
en.noTextHint: No text found. Check the OCR language in Settings.
en.slowOcr: OCR is processing. First use may take longer…
en.selectHistory: Select an item from the list to see details.
en.missingOcr: OCR language pack is not installed. Add the source language and Optical character recognition in Windows Settings > Time & language > Language & region.
en.paddleMissing: PaddleOCR is not installed. Open OverText Settings to install PaddleOCR.
en.paddleData: PaddleOCR data directory was not found
en.paddleInstaller: Could not start the PaddleOCR installer
en.paddleInstallFailed: PaddleOCR installation failed. Check your network and retry. Details:
en.paddleTimeout: PaddleOCR did not respond. Check network during the initial model download; see OverText/paddleocr/worker.log.
en.paddleWindows: PaddleOCR fallback is available only on Windows
en.invalidOcr: OCR language must be a language tag such as ja-JP or en-US
en.invalidUrl: Base URL must start with http:// or https://
en.rapidHint: Mobile is faster; Server may recognize some text better. Runtime and models download during installation. Images are processed locally; OCR works offline after installation.
en.rapidMissing: RapidOCR model is not installed. Open OverText Settings to download and install the selected model.
en.rapidData: RapidOCR data directory was not found
en.rapidInstallFailed: RapidOCR installation failed. Check network and retry. Details:
en.rapidWindows: RapidOCR is available only on Windows
en.rapidLanguage: This RapidOCR model supports Japanese, Chinese and English. Choose Windows OCR or PaddleOCR for other languages.

vi.title: Cài đặt — OverText
vi.installedOcr: Ngôn ngữ OCR Windows đã cài:
vi.autoHint: Tự động đọc tiếng Nhật, Trung và Anh. Với ngôn ngữ khác, chọn ngôn ngữ của ảnh bên trên.
vi.windowsHint: Windows OCR chỉ đọc ngôn ngữ đã cài. Chọn ngôn ngữ ảnh và cài language pack OCR tương ứng trong Windows.
vi.fallbackHint: Ngôn ngữ này sẽ dùng PaddleOCR khi Windows thiếu gói OCR.

vi.savedKey: Đã lưu an toàn — để trống để giữ nguyên
vi.keyHint: Văn bản trong ảnh chụp sẽ được gửi tới máy chủ trên. Key lưu trong Keychain (macOS) hoặc Credential Manager (Windows). Khi dịch vụ này lỗi, app báo lỗi và không tự gửi sang dịch vụ khác.
